title: PDF pages: endnotes over a final table, outline entries on the wrong page, a blank page in rare section breaks
symptom: endnotes overlap a table that ends the document; an outline entry opens the page before a heading moved by keep with next; a page break beside a wrapping floating picture, or an empty paragraph with page break before, just before a next-page section break still leaves a blank page
workaround: end the document with a paragraph after a final table; put a page break before such a heading; remove the page break before such a section break
